title: Volcanoes of Africa (hard)
intro: 10 volcanoes of Africa, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. Only the coasts are drawn and the full-points circle is small, so this is the hard version.

rounds.name: SW Usangu Basin
rounds.fact: SW Usangu Basin is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 2,179 m in the source data. The data places it in United Republic of Tanzania.

rounds.name: Nabro
